name: urban-destiny
description: AI-powered city matching platform that helps users find their ideal urban environment based on career potential, lifestyle preferences, cost of living, and happiness metrics. Users complete assessments and get personalized city recommendations with detailed breakdowns.

userStories.title: Project Setup & Infrastructure
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the base Next.js 14 project configured with Supabase, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui.
acceptanceCriteria: Next.js 14 app created with App Router
Supabase client configured with environment variables
Tailwind CSS configured with modern urban palette (blues, teals, warm grays)
shadcn/ui initialized with button, card, input, slider, progress components

userStories.title: Database Schema Design
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the complete database schema for user assessments and city data.
acceptanceCriteria: user_profiles table (id, user_id, current_city, assessment_complete, created_at)
cities table (id, name, country, population, cost_index, career_score, lifestyle_score, happiness_index, climate, image_url)
city_metrics table (id, city_id, metric_type, value, year, source)
assessment_responses table (id, user_id, category, question_id, answer_value, weight)
assessment_categories table (id, name: career/lifestyle/cost/happiness, description, icon)
city_matches table (id, user_id, city_id, overall_score, dimension_scores_json, created_at)
saved_cities table (id, user_id, city_id, notes, created_at)
Row Level Security for all user tables
Seed data for 30 major cities with metrics
Seed data for assessment questions (5 per category)

userStories.title: Authentication System
userStories.description: As a user, I want to sign up and login to save my city matches and preferences.
acceptanceCriteria: Protected routes for dashboard and saved cities
Anonymous assessment allowed (results shown but not saved)
Prompt to create account after completing assessment

userStories.title: Landing Page
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to see what the platform offers and start my assessment.
acceptanceCriteria: Hero section: 'Find Your Perfect City' with world map background
Value prop: AI analyzes career, lifestyle, cost, happiness factors
How it works: 1) Take Assessment, 2) Get Matches, 3) Explore Cities
Featured cities carousel showing 6 popular destinations

userStories.title: Career Assessment Section
userStories.description: As a user, I want to answer questions about my career goals and industry.
acceptanceCriteria: 5 questions: industry/field, remote vs office, salary expectations, career growth priority, startup vs corporate
Slider and multiple choice input types

userStories.title: Lifestyle Assessment Section
userStories.description: As a user, I want to answer questions about my lifestyle preferences.
acceptanceCriteria: 5 questions: climate preference, city size, nightlife importance, outdoor activities, cultural scene
Visual options with images where applicable
Navigation back to career and forward to cost

userStories.title: Cost of Living Assessment Section
userStories.description: As a user, I want to set my budget and cost preferences.
acceptanceCriteria: 5 questions: monthly budget range, housing priority, dining out frequency, transportation needs, savings goals

userStories.title: Happiness Assessment Section
userStories.description: As a user, I want to answer questions about what makes me happy in a city.
acceptanceCriteria: 5 questions: community importance, safety priority, work-life balance, diversity value, nature access
Calculate matches button triggers scoring algorithm

userStories.title: City Matching Algorithm
userStories.description: As a user, I want my assessment answers matched against city data to find my best fits.
acceptanceCriteria: Server function to calculate city match scores
Score calculation based on assessment weights vs city metrics
Career score: industry presence, salary levels, job growth
Lifestyle score: climate match, size preference, amenities
Cost score: budget fit with cost_index
Happiness score: safety, community, nature access metrics
Overall score: weighted average of 4 dimensions
Return top 10 matching cities sorted by score

userStories.title: Results Page with City Matches
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my top city matches with scores.
acceptanceCriteria: Results page at /results showing matched cities
Top match featured prominently with large card and photo
List of next 9 matches with cards showing: city name, country, overall score %, photo
Each card shows mini breakdown of 4 dimension scores
Click card to view full city profile at /city/[id]

userStories.title: City Detail Page
userStories.description: As a user, I want to view detailed information about a city.
acceptanceCriteria: City page at /city/[id] with full details
Hero image and city name with country
Your match score prominently displayed (if assessed)
Key metrics section: population, cost index, avg salary, climate
Pros and cons based on user's assessment (personalized)

userStories.title: City Comparison Tool
userStories.description: As a user, I want to compare two cities side by side.
acceptanceCriteria: Compare page at /compare with two city selectors
Side-by-side display of city photos and names
Dimension scores comparison with visual bars
Highlight which city wins each category
Overall recommendation based on user's assessment

userStories.title: Saved Cities & Dashboard
userStories.description: As a user, I want to save cities and access them from my dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard at /dashboard showing user's saved cities
Grid of saved city cards with match scores
Empty state with CTA to take assessment

userStories.title: City Explorer/Browse
userStories.description: As a user, I want to browse all cities even without taking assessment.
acceptanceCriteria: Explorer page at /explore listing all cities
Filter by: continent, population size, cost level, climate
Sort by: name, population, cost index, happiness index
Search input to filter by city name
City cards show basic metrics (no personalized scores unless assessed)
Pagination or infinite scroll for city list
CTA to take assessment for personalized matches

userStories.title: User Settings
userStories.description: As a user, I want to manage my account and preferences.

userStories.title: Mobile Navigation
userStories.description: As a user, I want intuitive mobile navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Bottom nav on mobile: Home, Explore, Results, Saved, Profile
